## Functions

### `Ratio`

```ts
Ratio(props: RatioProps): Html
```

A box that keeps its aspect ratio and lets its one child fill it — the
frame for an embedded video, a map, a cover image. Rounded, sunken
while the content loads.

## Types

### `RatioValue`

- `"16x9"`
- `"4x3"`
- `"1x1"`
- `"21x9"`
- `"3x4"`
- `"9x16"`

### `RatioProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ratio` | `RatioValue` |  |  |
| `content` | `Html` | yes | What fills the box: an iframe, a video, an image. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### An embedded video

The iframe fills the box; the box keeps 16:9 at any width.

```ts
Ratio({
  content: html`
    <iframe
      src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ"
      title="Product tour"
      loading="lazy"
      allowfullscreen
    ></iframe>
  `,
})
```

```html
<div class="ratio ratio--16x9">
  <iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ" title="Product tour" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>
```

### A square avatar crop

```ts
Ratio({
  ratio: "1x1",
  content: html`<img src="/media/team/ada.jpg" alt="Ada Lovelace" width="400" height="400">`,
})
```

```html
<div class="ratio ratio--1x1">
  <img src="/media/team/ada.jpg" alt="Ada Lovelace" width="400" height="400">
</div>
```
